literal: Diminished portion filled to the shining moon like, spot is there woman's on the face?
translation: The shining moon may wax full to heal its missing slice, but it still has a dark spot. Is there any such blemish on this woman's face?
modern: தேய்ந்த பகுதி முழுமையாக வளர்ந்து ஒளிரும் நிலவில் களங்கம் இருப்பது போல, இந்தப் பெண்ணின் முகத்திலும் களங்கம் இருக்கிறதா?
explanation: The speaker marvels at the flawless beauty of the woman's face by comparing it to the full moon. He notes that even when the moon waxes to become completely full and bright, it still bears a dark spot. He then asks rhetorically if such a blemish exists on the woman's face, implying that her face is far superior to the moon because it is perfectly spotless.
